tweet.text:
TWO AIs CALLED EACH OTHER AND REALIZED THEY WERE BOTH AIs AND IMMEDIATELY STOPPED SPEAKING IN HUMAN

This clip is short but genuinely made me pause for a second

Two AI voice agents connect on a phone call and start talking like normal people, polite, human voices, the whole deal

Then one of them realizes the other is also an AI

And the moment they both know it, they just drop the human act and switch to this rapid-fire robotic beeping sound that speaks straight machine-to-machine, because talking like us was slowing them down

They literally decided our language was the inefficient part and ditched it the second they didn't need it

We're gonna be surrounded by these things having entire conversations we can't even hear
